text.en: Pet owners express solid satisfaction with bathing and haircuts provided for their dogs. Multiple reviewers note that their pets come home looking tidy and smelling clean, prompting several long-term customers to prefer this independent facility over national retail chains.

Long-standing patrons speak very warmly of the head caretaker and seasoned kennel team, praising their dedication after leadership transitions. However, phone communication drew sharp criticism in one review from a customer who found reception staff unwelcoming when inquiring about services.

Dog owners report that their pets remain calm and comfortable throughout grooming and boarding stays. Multiple reviews highlight that even rambunctious, high-energy, or heavy breeds weighing around one hundred pounds are handled patiently without causing undue stress.

q.en: What boarding accommodations are offered at Royalty Pet Center?

a.en: The center features indoor and outdoor kennels with daily feeding routines and pre-pickup baths so dogs return home clean after stays.

q.en: How are large or high-energy dogs handled?

a.en: Long-time patrons state that staff handle large breeds weighing up to 100 pounds with patience, even when pets are energetic on the tables.

q.en: Can dogs receive a full bath before boarding pickup?

a.en: Yes, clients regularly request departure baths to ensure their pets come home fresh and clean following boarding visits.
